meta.purpose: Logo/icon exploration sprint — pre-processing for Narrative Studio + Midjourney
meta.notes: mission-rider maps to missionwriter (CLI writing/review missions). studio is the shared design-studio package, not a consumer product.

projects.name: Atelier
projects.truth: Standalone Vite host for extracted Hudson apps — Hero font studio, Shaper vector, OG generator, Day Stack, Assets. Workshop surface for building and dogfooding Hudson apps.
projects.audience: Arach + agent builders shipping Hudson-powered tools
projects.existingMark: Scout O-ring lives in atelier/assets/scout-icon (OpenScout derivative)

projects.name: OpenScout
projects.truth: Local-first broker/runtime for AI agents — discover, address, observe, compose harnesses (Claude, Codex) without reinventing state per surface.
projects.audience: Developers running multi-agent workflows on one machine
projects.existingMark: O-ring with gap + red live node (atelier scout-icon canon)

projects.name: Studio
projects.truth: Shared registry/shell/doc/code primitives extracted from OpenScout, Talkie, Hudson design studios — internal devtools for numbered proposals and studies.

projects.name: Hudson
projects.truth: Opinionated browser shell — nav, panels, command palette, terminal, canvas. AppShell for single products; WorkspaceShell for multi-app dotted-grid canvas. Also native macOS Canvas for tmux/terminals.
projects.audience: Builders who want chrome once and apps that plug in
projects.existingMark: Hudson workspace hero screenshot; no single canonical app icon yet

projects.name: Talkie
projects.truth: Voice memo and dictation workspace for Apple platforms — record, sync, transcribe, AI workflows on transcripts. MemoCard mark, Hot Mic dot, beam/wordmark system from Narrative Studio commissions.
projects.audience: Operators capturing speech and turning it into durable text/workflows
projects.existingMark: MemoCard + beam tracks from narrative-studio talkie commissions

projects.name: Lattices
projects.truth: Agentic workspace manager — screen map, window tiling, terminal sessions, OCR scan, layouts via .lattices.json. Mac menu bar + CLI.
projects.audience: macOS developers who want their desktop as a coherent API
projects.existingMark: 3x3 stepped grid squares on lattices.dev OG

projects.name: Mission Writer
projects.truth: Light CLI for writing and review missions on Cursor SDK — markdown mission files, spawn agents, optional multi-LLM contributor synthesis for review-rewrite flows.

projects.name: Linea
projects.truth: Reading-first experience — PDFs, scans, OCR, voice, document chat. Paper themes (Monochrome, Dusk, Paper). iOS + macOS + web moving to Hudson.
projects.audience: Readers who want listen, explain, and chat on documents
projects.existingMark: Paper themes in iOS; no canonical logo mark

projects.name: Fabric
projects.truth: Lightweight sandboxes for agentic workloads — one Sandbox interface across local, Daytona, E2B, exe.dev. exec, runCode, snapshot, handoff.
projects.audience: Agent builders needing portable compute envelopes
